BACKEND.description: Digital twin backend: containerlab (SSH) or eve-ng (REST API).

BACKEND_URLS.description: Optional URL per backend name (e.g. BACKEND_URLS['eve-ng']).

LOCATION_TYPE_NAME.description: Location type name where the Digital Twin button is shown (Nautobot 2+: no slug).

EVE_NG_URL.description: Base URL of the EVE-NG server (https://eve.example.com).

EVE_NG_LAB_FOLDER.description: Folder on EVE-NG where Nautobot labs are created.

EVE_NG_VERIFY_SSL.description: Verify TLS certificates when talking to EVE-NG.

EVE_NG_PLATFORM_MAP.description: Map Nautobot platform names to EVE-NG node specs (template/type/image/...).
